fusions.name: Inscribed Lash
fusions.desc: A lash written with a spell deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's resistances, and leaves it [Cursed] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a spoken word at the first enemy in reach for 8 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Rote Measure
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drilled Forms
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.
